title: The maps below show an industrial area in the town of Norbiton, and planned future...
prompt: The maps below show an industrial area in the town of Norbiton, and planned future development of the site. Sumarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guideHtml:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Norbiton Industrial Area (now vs planned future)
1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy hiện trạng khu công nghiệp Norbiton và kế hoạch phát triển trong tương lai.

→ Dạng: map – present vs future

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • Norbiton Industrial Area – now – future development

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / outlines
  • plan → proposed development / future layout

Ví dụ:

The maps illustrate the current layout of the Norbiton industrial area and the proposed future development.

3. Overview (ý chính)
  • Khu công nghiệp sẽ được chuyển đổi thành khu dân cư và dịch vụ
  • Hầu hết nhà máy bị loại bỏ
  • Thêm nhiều tiện ích như shops, school, medical centre, playground
  • Hệ thống giao thông được mở rộng và cải thiện (thêm roundabout, bridge)

→ tổng thể trở nên dân cư hóa và thân thiện hơn

4. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Hiện trạng (Now)
  • Khu vực chủ yếu là factories
  • Các nhà máy tập trung:
  • Xung quanh central roundabout
  • Dọc theo con đường phía đông
  • Có một tuyến đường chính chạy ngang phía dưới
  • River ở phía bắc, ngăn cách với farmland
  • Không có tiện ích công cộng đáng kể

→ Ý: khu vực mang tính công nghiệp, ít dịch vụ

BODY 2 – Phát triển tương lai (Future plan)
Chuyển đổi chức năng:
  • Hầu hết factories bị thay thế bởi housing
  • Khu vực trở thành khu dân cư
Tiện ích mới:
  • Shops (phía tây, gần town)
  • Medical centre (gần trung tâm)
  • School (phía đông)
  • Playground (gần khu dân cư)
Giao thông:
  • Giữ central roundabout
  • Thêm một roundabout nhỏ phía nam
  • Xây cầu bắc qua sông nối lên phía bắc
  • Đường xá được mở rộng và kết nối tốt hơn

→ Ý: chuyển từ industrial → residential + services

5. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be replaced by → được thay thế bởi
  • be demolished → bị phá bỏ
  • residential area → khu dân cư
  • amenities → tiện ích
  • infrastructure → cơ sở hạ tầng
  • be upgraded → được nâng cấp
sampleHtml:
The maps show the current layout of the Norbiton industrial area and its planned redevelopment.

Overall, the area will be transformed from an industrial zone into a mixed-use residential and community area, with factories removed and new public facilities added, alongside improved transport links.

At present, several factories are concentrated around a central roundabout, mainly to the east, with additional industrial units to the northwest. A main road runs along the south, while a river borders the northern edge, separating the site from farmland.

In the proposed plan, all factories will be demolished and replaced by housing, particularly to the east and northeast of the roundabout. New amenities will be introduced, including shops to the southwest, a medical centre just south of the roundabout, a school to the east, and a playground nearby. The road system will also be upgraded, with an additional roundabout added to the south and a new road crossing the river to the north, improving connectivity with the surrounding area.
chartDescription:
TYPE: map/plan
TITLE: Norbiton Industrial Area Now / Planned future development
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
Now: factory, Town, Farmland, River
Planned future development: housing, Shops, Medical centre, Playground, School, Town, Farmland, River
DATA:
Norbiton Industrial Area Now:
- River: runs horizontally across the top of the map, separating Farmland to the north from the industrial area.
- Farmland: located north of the River.
- Town: located west of a dashed vertical line on the left side of the map.
- Factories:
    - Three factories arranged in a semi-circle around a central circular road junction, located south of the River and east of the Town.
    - Two factories located east of the central circular road junction, connected by a road.
    - One factory located further east, connected by a road to the previous two.
- Roads: A main road runs horizontally from the Town towards the east, connecting to a circular road junction. Another road extends from this junction to the east, connecting to the factories.
Planned future development:
- River: runs horizontally across the top of the map, separating Farmland to the north from the developed area. A bridge crosses the river.
- Farmland: located north of the River.
- Town: located west of a dashed vertical line on the left side of the map.
- Housing:
    - Three housing blocks arranged in a semi-circle around a central circular road junction, located south of the River and east of the Town.
    - Two housing blocks located east of the central circular road junction, connected by a road.
    - One housing block located further east, connected by a road to the previous two.
    - One housing block located south of the central circular road junction.
    - One housing block located north of the central circular road junction, connected to a bridge over the river.
- Shops: Located southwest of the central circular road junction.
- Medical centre: Located southeast of the central circular road junction.
- Playground: Located east of the central circular road junction, north of the housing blocks.
- School: Located east of the Playground.
- Roads: A main road runs horizontally from the Town towards the east, connecting to a circular road junction. Another road extends from this junction to the south, connecting to another circular junction. A road extends north from the main circular junction, crossing the river via a bridge. Roads also connect to the Shops, Medical centre, Playground, School, and housing areas.
KEY FEATURES:
- All factories are replaced by housing.
- New facilities including shops, a medical centre, a playground, and a school are added.
- A new bridge is constructed over the river, connecting the developed area to the farmland.
- The road network is expanded, including a new road extending south from the main circular junction.
- The overall area becomes more residential and community-focused, moving away from industrial use.
